title: pretty SIENNA|Plus Size 3/4 Sleeve Midi Round Neck A-Line Sequin Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this Plus Size 3/4 Sleeve Midi Round Neck A-Line Sequin Wedding Guest Dress. The A-line silhouette flatters all body types, while the shimmering sequins bring a touch of glamour. With a classic round neck and 3/4 sleeves, this dress offers both style and comfort for special occasions. Perfect for weddings or formal events.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: 3/4 sleeve.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
